mapper.select: SELECT car_no AS carNo, COUNT(*) AS totalSeats, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 END) AS availableSeats FROM seat WHERE schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq} GROUP BY car_no ORDER BY car_no ASC

SELECT seat_seq AS seatSeq, schedule_seq AS scheduleSeq, car_no AS carNo, seat_no AS seatNo, seat_grade AS seatGrade, status, version FROM seat WHERE schedule_seq = #{scheduleSeq} AND car_no = #{carNo} AND seat_no = #{seatNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE seat SET status = #{newStatus}, version = version + 1 WHERE seat_seq = #{seatSeq}
